_about: Per-position interface detail for the deposited complexes used by the atlas: buried surface area, named partner residues, and the provenance each deposition states about its own chains.

_method.atoms: heavy atoms only; waters and ions removed
_method.glycans: glycan-only chains are adopted by the nearest protein chain, so an Fc glycan is Fc surface for both area and contacts
_method.sasa_free: area of the Fc chains alone, including their glycans
_method.sasa_bound: area of the same residues in the complex
_method.chain_choice: each position is reported for the Fc chain that buries the most surface, since receptor binding to the Fc dimer is asymmetric; every chain is kept under per_chain
_method.numbering: auth_seq_id, which is EU numbering in these entries
